scope: Completion A editorial inputs; selected bibliographic fields approved for Explorer projection by the user course correction.

dossiers.title: On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft
dossiers.note: Work date is not the 2020 twentieth-anniversary edition.
dossiers.summaryEn: A memoir about becoming a writer and a practical guide to the craft, bringing together King’s personal experience and advice on storytelling.

dossiers.title: Danse Macabre
dossiers.note: 2010 edition is not a new work.
dossiers.summaryEn: King explores the horror genre through books, film and television, reflecting on the stories and ideas that have shaped it.

dossiers.title: GUNS
dossiers.note: Essay published as a Kindle Single, not a novel.
dossiers.summaryEn: An essay in which King examines gun violence and the debate over gun control in the United States.

dossiers.title: Secret Windows: Essays and Fiction on the Craft of Writing
dossiers.note: Mixed nonfiction/fiction anthology; contents incomplete; Peter Straub introduction, not coauthorship.
dossiers.summaryEn: Essays, interviews and fiction about writing, collected alongside early stories and an introduction by Peter Straub.

dossiers.title: Charlie the Choo-Choo
dossiers.note: Beryl Evans is a Stephen King pseudonym; no extra author identity.
dossiers.summaryEn: A picture book about engineer Bob and his unusual train, written by Stephen King as Beryl Evans and illustrated by Ned Dameron.

dossiers.title: Hansel and Gretel
dossiers.note: King retelling and introduction; Maurice Sendak illustrations, not textual coauthorship.
dossiers.summaryEn: King retells the classic fairy tale with illustrations by Maurice Sendak, bringing two distinctive imaginations to a familiar journey into the woods.

dossiers.title: The Plant: Zenith Rising
dossiers.note: Unfinished novel; six 2000 installments and earlier limited parts are manifestations, not six works.
dossiers.summaryEn: An unfinished novel released in installments, centred on a small publishing house and an unexpected delivery.

dossiers.title: Storm of the Century
dossiers.note: Published original screenplay; not a preceding novel; existing TV identity untouched.
dossiers.summaryEn: King’s published original screenplay follows an isolated island community as a fierce winter storm approaches.

dossiers.title: Ghost Brothers of Darkland County
dossiers.note: Dramatic work: King book/libretto; John Mellencamp music/lyrics; stage premiere is not book publication.
dossiers.summaryEn: A stage musical with a book by Stephen King and music and lyrics by John Mellencamp, weaving a ghost story through a roots-inspired score.
